item.title: The Yoga Block Theory of Parenting
item.description: Sometimes, you gotta get an assist... here's why you shouldn't feel guilty about it!

item.title: I Was the Luckiest Parent in the World (and How You Can Be Too!)
item.description: The simple secret to parenting I learned from the leading experts in the field... and how you can incorporate them into your own life. No extra time, money, or stuff needed! It's a long read, but... you'll be rewarded for it with a whole new mindset about this big job of parenting you're taking on!

item.title: Are you social distancing your parenting?
item.description: Remember how weird social distancing felt? Well... using our phones around our kids might be having a similar effect. When we're on them, we're sharing the physical space, but not sharing human connection with our kids.

item.title: Disconnect to Connect: The Impact of Parental Phone Use on Children
item.description: While we worry a lot about the toll cell phone use is taking on our kids, we don't look at the impact our OWN digital distraction has on them. It's time to re-evaluate
